summary: Veea Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into demand promissory notes with NLabs Inc., a principal stockholder and affiliate of its CEO, totaling $1.15 million (three notes: $450k, $450k, $250k) at 10% interest, payable by December 31, 2026 or on demand, for working capital. The filing also notes a previously announced reverse stock split proposal approved at the annual meeting. These are routine financing and corporate governance matters, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or similar event. The loans are related-party transactions but do not constitute a special-situation category.
